title: Gare Montparnasse
axis: The Pasteur crossing roof sets the transverse X axis. The rail centerlines run toward positive Z away from Porte Océane and Place Raoul Dautry at the negative Z end.
limits: Standard PMTiles controls the mapped exteriors, roof court footprints and 24 rail alignments. The heights of the entrance, train floor and park deck are reconstructed from the photographs and standard viewer terrain.
The model includes the main public entrance volume and the covered track passages. Shop interiors, transit operations, planting schedules and restricted station interiors are outside this model.
The garden and forecourt follow the photographed configuration. The separate Tour Montparnasse remains a neighboring landmark.
